node.title: regex for numbers
node.author: BernieC
node.doctext: This must be easy, but... I have to keep chasing number formats in a regex ---first was to allow a decimal, then to allow a negative number.. I've just run into "2.5e-05". I can hack that into my regex, but I'm wondering if there's a "standard" regex that can deal with all the various number formast?
